The structure of Li3CoF6 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 40 atoms and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Co in an octahedral environment of six F neighbors, while Li appears in both octahedral (six F) and five-coordinate (one Co, four F) environments. Corner-sharing is observed between Co octahedra and between Co and Li octahedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
